title: Filipino-Style Smoked Clams
description: A flavorful Filipino-inspired dish featuring smoked clams in a savory broth, perfect for a seafood lover's evening dinner.

ingredients.name: Smoked clams
ingredients.notes: Fresh or frozen clams may be substituted, but smoked adds a unique flavor

ingredients.name: Lightly fish broth
ingredients.notes: Use low-sodium broth for a healthier option

ingredients.name: Menudo
ingredients.notes: Filipino tomato-based sauce adds a burst of flavor

ingredients.name: Onion
ingredients.notes: Chopped onion adds natural sweetness and crunch

ingredients.name: Garlic
ingredients.notes: Minced garlic enhances the savory flavor

ingredients.name: Lime juice
ingredients.notes: Freshly squeezed lime juice adds a touch of acidity

ingredients.name: Parsley
ingredients.notes: Chopped parsley adds a fresh, herbaceous note

ingredients.name: Salt and pepper
ingredients.notes: Season to taste with salt and pepper

instructions: 1. Rinse the smoked clams under cold water and set aside.
2. In a large saucepan, heat the fish broth over medium heat.
3. Add the menudo, onion, and garlic to the saucepan and cook until the onion is translucent.
4. Add the smoked clams to the saucepan and cook for 2-3 minutes or until heated through.
5. Squeeze the lime juice over the clams and stir to combine.
6. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
7. Garnish with chopped parsley and serve immediately.
